name: AXM Game Forge
summary: One game-development workspace with a shared 2D Physics Lab, instant map preview, reviewed package building, modular runtimes, multiplayer lobby and play-test flow.
notes: Game Forge v1.2 consumes AXM Physics 2D v0.2.2 for paused-by-default experiments, explicit project snapshots, contact lifecycle, collision filtering, contact-aware sleep/wake including moving supports, permanent canaries, adversarial fixtures, opt-in spatial-hash equivalence evidence, live diagnostics and bounded replay-trace export. It does not claim scientific validation, rigid-body rotation, joints, fluids, deformables, default scalable broadphase or general 3D physics. Existing Game Hub runtimes, four-seat lobby, QR controllers, package verifier and Studio asset handoff remain the execution path.
